versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the pdf-creation skill using fpdf2 for PDF generation.
- Provides a lightweight, Unicode-safe alternative to reportlab, suitable when reportlab isn’t available or complex styling isn’t needed.
- Includes guidance for using custom TTF fonts for full Unicode support.
- Demonstrates basic usage and table generation with examples.
- Notes common pitfalls, including font limitations and coordinate differences from reportlab.
